Name: PPJA - Starbrew Valley_A Collection of New Alcoholic Drinks
Author: Pathoschild
TagLine: Ever wondered why Gus only sells beer? Yeah, me too. Imagine if a bar only sold one type of drink and one flavor; they'd go out of business pretty quick. Adds new drinks & recipes to the Stardrop Saloon.
Description:
![](https://i.imgur.com/KuccdOC.png)﻿
Ever wondered how Gus manages to stay open? Yeah, me too. Pam and Shane can't be spending that much and you have crops to attend to. Introducing Starbrew Valley ~ Now the Stardrop Saloon is an actual bar.

Check out a companion mod made by spacechase0 - [More Rings](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2054)﻿ to help negate the booze effects

![](https://i.imgur.com/rL96BeA.png)

- ChefRude
- Rjenyawd
- ParadigmNomad

Thank you for helping to sprite some of the drinks from our long list!

If you would like to contribute to the project, we welcome pull requests on our [Github repo](https://github.com/paradigmnomad/PPJA)﻿!  You may also submit ideas or translations there.

![](https://i.imgur.com/LKwk9jp.png)﻿

- Balancing is an issue, but I have done my best for version 1.0.0
- JA does not support the named 'Tipsy' buff but rather Speed -1. All alcoholic drinks give a minimum debuff of Speed -1

![](https://i.imgur.com/cVevYNe.png)﻿

﻿See MouseyPounds database!
﻿
[L I N K](https://mouseypounds.github.io/ppja-ref/index.html)

![](https://i.imgur.com/Eqdpuvd.png)

﻿﻿- Latest version of [Json Assets](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720)
- Latest version of [SMAPI](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI)
- Latest version of [SpaceCore](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348)
- Latest version of [Mail Framework Mod](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536) (optional, to get seeds/recipes in the mail)https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI
- [Artisan Valley](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1926)﻿ + all dependencies

Optional

- Latest version of [Champagne Wishes](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5721)﻿ (for 3 recipes)
- Latest version of [Fizzy Drinks](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5342)﻿ (for 2 recipes)
- Latest version of [Custom Crafting Stations](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6293)﻿ (for use with the optional Cocktail Bar)
﻿
![](https://i.imgur.com/kLbxt2U.png)﻿
﻿
Step 1. Install SMAPI, Json Assets, SpaceCore, Artisan Valley (+ dependencies), and Mail Framework Mod (optional).
Step 2. Download this mod and extract the zip file anywhere you would like. There are 2 files included in the main download:

[JA] Starbrew Valley
[MFM] Starbrew Valley

Step 3. Drag & Drop the extracted folder(s) directly into the /Mods folder.

![](https://i.imgur.com/MnkF0nq.png)﻿

- Delete every existing food item made from this mod
- Remove the corresponding folder(s) inside /Mods
﻿
**If you miss any (especially in your inventory) you can crash your game.**
